question: What state is attained by one freed from all diseases, and in relation to yogis does that state involve union?
premises: One is freed from all diseases.
That one is in relation to yogis.
That relation is characterized as union together with yogis.
inference: One freed from all diseases attains union together with yogis.
uncertainties: Nature of the union not specified
plain_english: Freed from all diseases, one attains union together with yogis.
